doctorMode.title: Doctor Mode
doctorMode.dashboardSubtitle: Bitácora, doctor linking, and shared readings
doctorMode.subtitle: Log your readings, link with a doctor when you choose, and share only the categories you allow. The app never labels values as high, low, or dangerous.

gate.title: Doctor access required
gate.needVerifiedPlan: Patient data is available only with an active doctor plan and a human-verified professional credential that has not expired. Unverified doctors cannot see patient data.

onboarding.title: Doctor profile
onboarding.hint: Enter your legal name and professional credentials. A registry check is queued for human review — nothing is auto-approved.
onboarding.name: Display name
onboarding.required: Legal name, specialty, and credential fields for your country are required.

verification.title: Professional verification
verification.label: Verification
verification.queued: Submitted for manual review. You will see the decision here when an admin finishes reviewing.
verification.expiredHint: Your verification has expired. Please submit again for review.
verification.identityHint: Identity check (INE/passport + liveness) opens in the vendor flow when configured. We do not store ID images.

linking.title: Patient ↔ doctor linking
linking.hubHint: Create a short-lived invite or enter a code. You confirm the link and control every consent toggle (all off by default).
linking.enterDoctorHint: Enter the code your doctor shared. You will confirm before any data is shared.
linking.enterPatientHint: Enter the code your patient shared. You must be verified and entitled.
linking.linked: Link confirmed. Consent categories start OFF.
linking.invalid: Invalid or already used invite code.
linking.doctorNotReady: Doctor must have a verified cédula and an active doctor plan.
linking.consentHint: Each category is OFF by default. Turn on only what you want this doctor to see. Revoking cuts access immediately.
linking.revokeMessage: This doctor will immediately lose access to your shared data.

bitacora.title: Bitácora
bitacora.hubHint: Quick log for blood pressure, glucose, weight, and symptoms — raw values only.
bitacora.disclaimer: Values are stored as entered. The app does not interpret them as normal, high, low, or dangerous.
bitacora.chartsHint: Simple plots of your numbers — no reference bands or risk colors.

doctor.hubHint: Requires doctor plan + verified cédula. Unverified doctors cannot see patient data.
doctor.noPatients: No linked patients with active consent yet.
doctor.rawOnly: Shared readings as raw values only — no clinical labels.
doctor.medsSharedHint: Medication list is shared (read-only). Full med sync arrives with live consent filters in a later pass.
doctor.adherenceSharedHint: Reminder adherence is shared when available from the patient's reminders.

alerts.title: Alert limits
alerts.hint: Notify me only when a new reading crosses a limit I set. Alerts never say a value is high, low, or dangerous.
alerts.pushBody: A reading crossed a limit you set. Open the app for details.
alerts.crossedLimitDetail: A reading crossed a limit you set.
alerts.crossedLimitDetailNamed: Reading {{observed}} {{relation}} the limit of {{limit}} that you configured

patientHub.title: Bitácora & doctors
patientHub.dashboardSubtitle: Log readings and control what your doctor can see
patientHub.subtitle: Log your readings and link with a doctor when you choose. Doctors use the separate AuricRX for Doctors app.
patientHub.auditHint: Recent link, consent, and doctor-read events.
patientHub.doctorAppNote: Your doctor views shared data in AuricRX for Doctors (com.auricrx.doctors), not inside this patient app.

compliance.disclaimer: AuricRX Médicos is a tool for organizing information. It does not replace your clinical judgment.
compliance.disclaimerShort: Organizing tool — does not replace clinical judgment.
compliance.notForEmergencies: This channel is not for emergencies. For emergencies, use local emergency services.

digest.title: Morning digest
digest.subtitle: Only what is new since your last look — sorted by recency, not by health status.

preVisit.title: Pre-visit one-pager
preVisit.subtitle: Descriptive counts, last readings with dates, dose-log totals, patient questions, and new files.
preVisit.empty: Nothing to show for this period.

appointmentRequest.title: Request appointment
appointmentRequest.subtitle: Draft a message, review it, then send. Nothing is written to your calendar.
appointmentRequest.sent: Request sent for the patient to review.

calendar.title: Today's agenda
calendar.subtitle: Read-only from Google or Outlook. All times use your timezone.
calendar.stubHint: Calendar OAuth is not connected yet. Agenda stays unavailable (fail closed).
calendar.stale: Calendar sync is stale. Agenda hidden until a fresh sync succeeds.

officeHours.title: Office hours
officeHours.subtitle: You choose which days and time windows accept patient messages, in your timezone. You can pause messaging while away. Outside your windows, messages queue for the next one.
officeHours.windowsHint: Windows per day (24h). Example: 09:00-13:00, 16:00-20:00. Leave blank to close that day.
officeHours.pausedHint: Messaging is paused. New patient messages stay queued until you resume.

aiInsights.title: AI insights
aiInsights.body: Registered AI review is not available in Phase 1. Join the waitlist if you want to hear when it opens.

messaging.title: Messages
messaging.needsActionHint: Structured patient requests that are due in your current office window.
messaging.notForEmergencies: This channel is not for emergencies.
messaging.writeHint: Choose a request type. This is not open chat and not for emergencies.
messaging.queuedNotice: Outside office hours. Your message is queued for the doctor's next window. No reply is expected until then.
messaging.pausedNotice: The doctor paused messaging. Your message is queued. No reply is expected until messaging resumes.
